agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only at the intended v2.1 boundary and must never become verified Experience through repetition.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1; keep it observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics only, not calibrated capability units.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, awake time, window age, heartbeat count and wake count are invalid substitutes.

disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: event_kind has no single canonical typed parser across v2/v2.1. experience_candidate_delta uses str(event_kind).strip().upper(); select_gear_v2 later calls event_kind.upper() on the raw caller object; select_gear_v2_1 uses str(event_kind).upper() without strip before verified/operational classification. Non-string values can therefore crash the inherited v2 path, while whitespace-padded strings can receive positive credit in one path but fail verified/operational classification in another.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one canonical EventKind parser shared by v2/v2.1 and the ledger; parse exactly once, reject non-string/ambiguous values fail-closed, normalize whitespace/case once, and make credit, verified eligibility, ledger classification and v2.1 projection consume that same canonical value.

disagreements.finding: v1 accepts proposed_autonomy in 0..6, but only applies the cap when proposed_autonomy > 0 and then forces normal selection through max(2,...); proposed_autonomy=0 does not constrain autonomy and proposed_autonomy=1 can still return G2.
disagreements.required_change: Define one canonical proposed_autonomy 0..6 meaning shared by v1/v2/v2.1, or explicitly recontract the field as non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and installation/runtime identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted provenance, freshness, scope and policy metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with immutable binding and exactly-once replay semantics.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: v2 can deny real Experience outside canonical C_VERIFIED while v2.1 independently recomputes positive verified_experience_delta from raw caller event_kind plus event_independently_verified.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must consume immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt or exact inherited eligibility and must not re-mint verified credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is still granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe; raw caller events may be analytics-only.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency, with frozen metric definitions and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: EventKind parser divergence can create path-dependent classification: the same logical event may gain credit in one layer but lose verified/operational status in another, invalidating ledger and longitudinal comparisons.
Non-string event_kind values can crash the inherited v2 path before bounded v2.1 handling, creating denial-of-evidence and batch/order bias.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate or suppress longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.

GB21-EVENT-KIND-TYPE-177: event_kind=None/123/true/list/mapping/object must fail closed through the same GearboxGuardError boundary; no raw AttributeError/TypeError and no silent str coercion into an authoritative class.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-CROSSPATH-178: VERIFIED_RECOVERY and DURABLE_PROGRESS with leading/trailing whitespace must not produce credit/classification disagreement between v2 and v2.1.
Secretary freshness-forge and exact AuthorityDecisionEnvelope projection tests remain required.
Shift-rate provenance, small-n false-trigger, chatter/release and paired performance non-regression tests remain required.
Cross-run replay, rollback replay, same-evidence/new-ID lineage and exact verifier receipt tests remain required.

Paired speed baseline must use durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency under sealed matched workloads and randomized/crossover order.

blocks: claim that event classification is canonical while v2/v2.1 parse event_kind differently and can crash or diverge on type/whitespace
claim that proposed_autonomy is a trustworthy hard maximum-autonomy/gear ceiling under current v1 floor semantics
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

One canonical typed EventKind parser is shared by v2/v2.1 and ledger; non-string/ambiguous values fail closed and whitespace/case normalization cannot produce cross-path classification or credit divergence.
Secretary signal provenance/freshness is replay-resistant and fresh authority is projected from an exact trusted authority decision, not caller booleans.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted denominator/sample/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression passes.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.
Accepted event identity and evidence lineage are durable and rollback-resistant; exact replay NO_OPs, same evidence/new ID cannot re-credit, and same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and authoritative operational credit requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt.
Credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are forbidden as capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance truth or promotion thresholds.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with frozen metric definitions, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Formal A->B->C is not entered until candidate vetoes are resolved; v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
